nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

**Key inputs**

- **prompt**: describe the shots, camera moves, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

nodes.title: 3×5s 连续分段 / 12GB RTX 5070
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3：3×5 秒连续分段

- Segment 1：T2VA；Segment 2/3：上一段 refined 视频末帧自动接入 first_frame 的 I2VA。
- 每段：0.3MP 首遍、LightX2V Turbo 8 steps、H3 latent 0.7MP、二次 6 steps / denoise 0.30。
- Segment 2/3 的二次 refine 使用无首帧文本条件，避免 I2V 图像 token 与放大 latent 的空间尺寸冲突；首遍 I2V 已把连续性写入 latent。
- 两个边界各使用 RIFE v4.26 生成 4 张中间帧，并等量裁掉边界附近原帧；合并后仍为 370 帧，24fps，约 15.42 秒。
- 音频同步按段生成，后两段各裁掉约 0.04 秒后顺序拼接。
- 最终同时保存约 1120×640 合并原片与 RTX VSR **精确 1920×1080** 版本。

连续性依赖上一段末帧、匹配的 I2VA 提示词、固定场景/镜头/肤质描述；生成模型无法提供逐像素绝对保证。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, naturalistic observational video in one uninterrupted eye-level medium-wide shot inside a modest, tidy Tokyo apartment on an overcast morning. One entirely fictional 20-year-old Japanese adult woman, unmistakably mature, consenting and alone, is completely nude from the opening frame. She has ordinary natural adult body proportions, shoulder-length straight black hair with a few loose strands, minimal makeup, and matte natural skin with visible pores and subtle color variation; there is no body oil, cosmetic gloss, airbrushing or beauty-filter finish. She sits near the edge of a bed with slightly rumpled pale cotton sheets, absorbed in her private experience and never performing for the camera. The camera remains nearly static with a very slow small-amplitude truck right. From 0.00 to 1.30 seconds, she lowers her gaze, exhales, and lets one hand move gradually from her lower abdomen between her thighs. From 1.30 to 4.30 seconds, she leans back slightly on her other arm and begins masturbating with slow, natural hand movement while her breathing deepens and two soft, involuntary breathy moans accompany her exhalations. From 4.30 to 5.17 seconds, she maintains the same hand position and pace, ending mid-exhalation in a stable pose that can continue directly into the next segment. Cool diffused window light is the main light; white walls, light-gray curtains, cotton bedding and muted wood remain consistent. Use a natural 35mm perspective, moderate depth of field, restrained neutral color, realistic adult anatomy, coherent hands and fingers, and stable facial identity. Keep the moment candid and non-performative: no direct eye contact with the lens, exaggerated facial expressions, glamour posing, warm orange cast, oily highlights, plastic skin, extreme proportions, explicit close-up framing, morphing, duplicate limbs, cuts, text, logos or watermarks.

overall_soundscape: Fine rain taps softly against the window above a low apartment ventilation hum and distant muted Tokyo traffic. Cotton sheets shift quietly with subtle hand-on-skin movement, deepening breaths and two soft, natural female moans; the final exhalation remains unfinished at the segment boundary.
